universities.name: Robert Gordon University
universities.summary: Robert Gordon University is a recognised Scottish degree-awarding university in Aberdeen. Its BSc (Hons) Computer Science is an on-campus, full-time route with September entry or January entry through its International College, published international tuition of £18,940 for 2026/2027, and an optional paid placement year.
universities.campusLifestyle: Computer Science is delivered through RGU's School of Computing, Engineering and Technology. The course page identifies a cyber-security lab, nine IT labs with 335 desktop workstations, and project computing labs for honours-year work.
universities.cityProfile: Aberdeen is the study location. RGU's 2026/2027 planning guide lists university accommodation at £109–£189 per week, food and toiletries at about £50 per week, bus travel at £2.25 per journey, and books or stationery at £25–£40 per month. Tuition is separate from these figures.
universities.practicalExposure: The four-year route includes programming, databases, web development, data structures and algorithms, then modern programming paradigms, Internet of Things and AI-enabled systems. An optional paid summer or 12-month placement is supported by a dedicated coordinator and placement supervisor; placements are not guaranteed.
universities.hostelOverview: RGU publishes 2026/2027 accommodation options from £109.13 per week for a 42-week Woolmanhill standard room to £189.56 per week for a 42-week ensuite room at Crathie Student Village. Lease length, room type and availability determine the final cost.
universities.dietarySupport: RGU's 2026/2027 living-cost guide estimates food and toiletries at about £50 per week and eating out at £7–£15 per meal. It does not present a compulsory university meal plan for this course.
universities.safetyOverview: RGU's Student Immigration Team supports international students through the CAS and visa process. The course page also identifies the Inclusion Centre for applicants who disclose a disability, long-term condition, mental-health issue or specific learning difference.
universities.studentSupport: Students have Moodle access for learning resources and interaction with tutors and classmates. RGU also lists study-skills support for academic writing, time management, maths, statistics and IT, alongside library workshops and drop-ins.
whyChoose: A four-year BSc (Hons) route with a published optional industrial-placement year.
BCS accredits the programme for Chartered IT Professional and Engineering Council academic requirements.
The 2026/2027 international fee is published course-by-course rather than as a general estimate.
The course has computing labs, a cyber-security lab and project facilities described by RGU.
thingsToConsider: International tuition is £18,940 per year for 2026/2027, with a £50 materials charge and separate living costs.
The placement route is optional and placements are not guaranteed.
January international entry is through International College at Robert Gordon University, not the direct September route.
Applicants whose first language is not English need IELTS 6.0 overall with no component below 5.5, or an accepted equivalent.
bestFitFor: Applicants seeking a Scotland-based computer-science degree with programming, systems and project work.
Students who meet the academic route or can use RGU's International College pathway.
Applicants planning for a September start or a January International College entry point.

faq.question: Is Robert Gordon University recognised in Scotland?
faq.answer: Yes. The Scottish Government lists Robert Gordon University as a recognised higher-education body with degree-awarding powers.

faq.question: How long is BSc Computer Science at RGU?
faq.answer: The standard on-campus full-time route is four years. A four-year route with an additional one-year placement is also published.

faq.question: What is the 2026/2027 international tuition fee?
faq.answer: RGU lists £18,940 per year for international students on this course for 2026/2027. The page also lists a £50 materials charge and separate accommodation and living costs.

faq.question: What English score does RGU require?
faq.answer: Applicants whose first language is not English need IELTS 6.0 overall with no component below 5.5, or an accepted equivalent.

faq.question: How can international students apply?
faq.answer: First-year applicants can use UCAS or RGU's direct application route. International fee-paying students seeking January entry apply through the International College at Robert Gordon University.

faq.question: Is a placement guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. The course offers optional paid summer or 12-month placements, supported by a coordinator and supervisor, but RGU states that placements are not guaranteed.

faq.question: What does the course cover?
faq.answer: RGU describes object-oriented design, systems development, programming, databases, web development, data structures, algorithms, AI-enabled systems and a substantial honours project.

faq.question: What should I budget for accommodation?
faq.answer: RGU's 2026/2027 accommodation guide lists university rooms from £109.13 to £189.56 per week across named room types and locations; contract length changes the total.

admissionsContent.international: International applicants can apply through UCAS or directly to RGU for September entry; January international entry is through ICRGU.

fee.notes: RGU publishes £18,940 for each of four years for international students. The calculated four-year total excludes the optional placement year, £50 materials charge, accommodation and personal costs.

restrictions: International applicants must meet course entry and English-language requirements or use an available International College route.

admissionsContent.overview: International applicants can apply for the BSc route through UCAS or RGU's direct application route. RGU offers additional entry points through ICRGU where direct entry requirements are not met.

eligibility.intro: RGU publishes standard academic routes and considers equivalent overseas qualifications. English-language evidence is required where English is not the applicant's first language.
items: Equivalent overseas qualification considered by RGU.
IELTS 6.0 overall with no component below 5.5, or accepted equivalent.
Academic transcripts and senior-school or college certificate for application.

applicationSteps: Choose UCAS or RGU's direct undergraduate application route for first-year entry.
Use ICRGU for January international entry or where the College pathway is appropriate.
admissionsContent.deadlinesNote: RGU states that application deadlines apply for September 2026 and January 2027 starts; the active deadline depends on course choice and start date.

programmes.feeNotes: International tuition is £18,940 per year in 2026/2027, plus a published £50 materials cost. Accommodation, travel, books and placement/study-abroad costs are separate.
